post.description: Step 1 of the two-step upload flow. Use the returned `uploadUrl` to PUT the file directly to R2, then call `POST /media/confirm` with the returned `key`. Allowed MIME types: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, `image/webp`. The signed URL is bound to the requesting user — only that user can confirm the upload. Requires permission: `media:create`.

200.description: Returns a pre-signed PUT URL (valid for 15 minutes) and the storage key; use the key when calling POST /media/confirm

400.description: Validation failed, or MIME type not in the allowlist

post.summary: Request a pre-signed R2 upload URL

post.description: Step 2 of the two-step upload flow. Call after successfully PUTting the file to R2 using the signed URL. The server verifies the key is one this user requested via `/media/upload-url`, and authoritatively reads the actual stored Content-Type and Content-Length from R2 (client-supplied values are not trusted). Requires permission: `media:create`.

201.description: Media record registered in the database; returns the full media object including the public CDN URL

400.description: Validation failed, the key is not under the managed prefix, or the file was not uploaded to R2

403.description: The key was issued to a different user

404.description: No pending upload exists for that key — request a new upload URL first

post.summary: Confirm an upload and register the media record

info.title: imamzain.org API
info.description:
REST API for imamzain.org — Islamic content management, digital library, gallery, forms, and contest.

**Authentication:** Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT. Obtain one via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

**Language:** Send `Accept-Language: ar` (or any supported ISO 639-1 code) to receive translated content. Falls back to the default translation when the requested language is unavailable.
